Threat actors leveraged the flaw to obtain Admin API Keys and inject malicious JavaScript loaders for ClickFix attacks. Confirmed victims include DuckDuckGo, Harvard University, and Oxford University, along with personal blogs, software development blogs, and cryptocurrency sites. Qianxin identified at least two threat actor groups conducting the poisoning operations.
